quarterly_data.signal: CEO Albert Bourla on business development: in the last three years Pfizer has 'invested close to $80 billion, of which 80% it is in three business deals' - Seagen (a platform rather than a product, the most expensive of them, doing ahead of expectations every quarter), Biohaven with NURTEC ODT and Metsera - and the focus now is on maximizing the value of these investments.
quarterly_data.figure: close to $80 billion invested in business development, 80% in three deals
